headline: Apple Stock Drops 4.5% on Disappointing Gross Margin Outlook
summary: Apple shares declined 4.5% in premarket trading after investors expressed disappointment regarding the company’s gross margin outlook and slowing services revenue growth.
why: As one of the world's largest publicly traded companies, Apple's margin guidance and service revenue trends heavily influence technology sector sentiment and major equity indexes.

impacts.name: Apple Inc
impacts.why: Weaker-than-expected margin forecasts directly reduce the valuation multiples investors apply to the stock.
